title: 30th Anniversary Play Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: She soars on wings of Serra's light, her sword of faith meting out justice to the wicked.
The most frightening storms are those not woven by nature's hand.
Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.
Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it." —Barrin, master wizard
"Find shelter where none but the angels can reach you." —Kor saying
Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.
"I have watched over this land since the first seedling emerged from the primeval soil."
It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.
"The entire parish is gone. This was no execution. This was a massacre." —Bishop Cawle of Elgaud
When she's hungry, no one is safe.
"Nobody asked you to butt in, Jace. But thanks." —Chandra Nalaar
"No symphony can compare to the melody of the ferrox's roar."
"It must be infuriating, to pour so much rage into your assault and see it wasted. Perhaps you'll learn something from this."
"Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."
paragraphs.card: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

paragraphs.text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."
The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.
